kind_of_thing.quote: A clinic (or outpatient clinic or ambulatory care clinic) is a health facility that is primarily focused on the care of outpatients.

kind_of_made_thing.quote: A clinic is a medical facility that gives health care for patients in an area.

what_people_do_there.why: A clinic is a health facility where people go to get care and treatment for injuries or illness, so people mostly go there to get well.
